unresolved.note: Neither smartworlddevelopers.com, the Trump Residences project site nor Smartworld's March 2026 press release states a marketed possession date; only the RERA completion date (Apr 2033) is available, recorded as reraCompletionDate. The 31-05-2032 date that also appears in the filing belongs to Smartworld Sky Arc (Part G), not this project.

Builder publishes no 'onwards' price or price list. Smartworld's press release (newsvoir.com, 12 Mar 2026) gives only per-sq-ft rates: 'prices rising from Rs. 25,000 per sq. ft. at launch to Rs. 32,000 per sq. ft.' The project was reported 100% sold out on launch day. Our Rs 7.99 Cr cannot be confirmed or corrected from builder sources.
